reason: assertion_fail: a failed criterion demands a surface the plan's own delivery mechanism cannot write (bad criterion)

misses.statement: The pull request description carries the measured size and SSIM table for every preset, old and new values side by side, before the change is approved.
misses.rationale: The issue says reviewers must see the measured numbers for every preset before they approve, and reviewers read the pull request description first.
misses.observed: the pull request description carries only the plan summary written when the pull request opened; the media runner job pushed bench/results/presets.md with the full table to the branch, but its contents-only token could not edit the description; the criterion failed
misses.expected: a criterion observing a surface the delivery mechanism can write, such as the committed bench/results/presets.md
misses.steps_taken: read the pull request description at the head commit, then read bench/results/presets.md on the branch
misses.repro_handle: gh pr view --json body --jq .body | grep -c SSIM
